_comment: Tunable game rules. Senior women's singles. Change numbers here, not in code.
_keys_comment: Key layouts. Each element names its layout in elements.csv. A layout is a list of key groups; a sequence takes turns between the groups, so two groups on opposite sides make the hands jump back and forth. Harder jumps get wider reaches.
_luck_comment: Landing roll: after you type an element, chance it still slips one step = (100 - effective consistency)% x luck_scale. Surprise: chance per layout that one upcoming key changes while you type.
_conditions_comment: Condition of the week, best first. Roll = 1-100 - fatigue/2 + (composure-50)/5; the first tier whose min the roll reaches applies its consistency modifier.
